text:
Hi there. I travelled from New Zealand to see Dr V for labiaplasty.
Whole process was 3 hours done under local anesthetic.Cost for me 40 000 baht.
I could only feel when the anesthetic was injected. Slight discomfort. I could not feel anything during surgery.
Once it wore off I felt alot of pain. So rang Dr V and he told me what to get from pharmacy. A stronger pain killer which has worked a treat. I have kept using the ice pack alot and limited walking. Follow all instructions and things should be fine. Its day 2 for me. Im just chilling with the ice pack! Im not drinking to much fluids so I dont have to pee to much.There is a little bit of pain but definatly not alot.
I have had a look at my new vagina and can say already Im so happy I could cry. What a wonderful job he has done. Cant wait till it is healed. It is now 2 weeks on. And I have healed so well and it is looking so different and just how I imagined and dreamed it would look.
The staff are very lovely and caring to and Dr V makes u feel very comfortable.
I am so so so happy to have made this choice!
Its now 11 months later! And I am so very happy I made this choice. I am no longer concious but Instead love showing my boyfriend! Sorry I just thought Id be honest!!
Thank You Dr V.
